semantic_dependency_basis: Each edge has explicit consumed deliverable and rationale in the destination node; not page-order rotation
cache_rule: Re-executing a node does not invalidate healthy independent branches. Descendants invalidated only if their consumed input/version changes; same output hash permits reuse.

natural_feedback.action: If owning extractor output invalid, retry that node within reserved budget; invalidate affected committed descendants only. Valid source records in other branches remain cached.
Check typed operands and provenance; no LLM rerun for a deterministic arithmetic formatting issue; repair failed source node only if independently evidenced.
Preserve UNKNOWN/CONFLICT. If conflict is already present in source, no repeated model calls to force resolution.
Stop or legally reassign future nodes within remainder; unresolved billed/cancelled calls remain UNKNOWN. No automatic API retries.
Current semantic guard not calibrated for these contracts; cannot use private reference to trigger repair.

recovery_analysis.minimal_legal_recovery: For a known invalid node, that node plus actually affected already-committed descendant outputs; pending descendants are first executions, not extra retries
recovery_analysis.closure_note: These are possible dependency invalidation sets, not observed faults or multiple competing R actions at the same state
recovery_analysis.identifiability: With one required legal R, R-only may coincide with Static recovery and Joint with pi-only. Different failure locations do not prove two R choices at one state. No larger R added without evidence.

pi_analysis.identity_basis: Archived real calibration model labels only; current provider version not revalidated
pi_analysis.dynamic_opportunity: At source-branch completion, remaining LLM merge/synthesis nodes may be reassigned; no observed ranking reversal or benefit yet
pi_analysis.independent_confirmatory_status: NOT_CERTIFIED; current source/reference/DAG design is recorded development exposure

optimizations_not_applied.merge: May combine interpretation/finalization only if all typed outputs, source lineage, explicit UNKNOWN and six deliverables retained. No measured saving asserted.
optimizations_not_applied.split: Split only on separately sourced responsibilities or independently checkable calculations; not arbitrary page slicing.
optimizations_not_applied.remove_edges: Only if destination contract demonstrably no longer consumes parent; cannot remove compulsory source comparison.
